svg.title: Toric fan diagram
svg.desc: Three successive triangular fans labelled Σ of P³, Σ₃,₃, and Σ of Q₀, with subdivisions at w₃ and w₂, beside a polyhedral diagram with solid front edges and dashed rear edges. Vertices v₀, v₁, v₂, v₃, w₃, and w₂ retain the labels and colours of the supplied figure. The displayed relations are w₃ = 3v₀ + 2v₁ + v₂ and w₂ = 2v₀ + v₁.
